content.title: Big Tech’s Market Dominance Stirs Debate on Concentration Risks
content.summary: The debate is becoming more urgent as Nividia, Microsoft, Apple Inc., Alphabet Inc., Amazon.com Inc. and Meta Platforms Inc. account for more than 30% of the benchmark index, more than three times their weighting from a decade ago.  For Scott Chronert, Citi Research’s managing director, the concentration is a badge of honor, well-deserved for a group that continues to deliver unparalleled growth in sales and earnings.

content.title: Kodak CEO Says There's 'Substantial Doubt' About Whether Or Not The 133-Year-Old Company Will Continue
content.summary: The Eastman Kodak Company (NYSE:KODK) is warning investors that it may not exist for much longer. The 133-year-old photography company pointed to ongoing struggles to satisfy its debt obligations, which have left the company with "substantial doubt about [its] ability to continue," as the primary reason behind its possible shuttering. content.title: As Kodak Terminates Its Pension Plans, What Top Companies Still Offer This Retirement Perk?
content.summary: Kodak has announced plans to shut down its pension plan, and it is not alone. A lot of corporations are dropping traditional pensions in favor of less risky defined contribution plans. That means retirement savers need to weigh their options and tread carefully when planning for the future.
